title: And Will the God of Grace
description: And Will the God of Grace in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 8 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 83, headed “A complaint against persecutors”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: And will the God of grace Per-pet-ual si-lence keep? The God of jus-tice hold his peace, And let his ven-geance sleep?

lines: And will the God of grace
The God of justice hold his peace,
The men that hate thy saints and thee
And malice with her watchful eye,
The lion and the stupid ass
"Till not the name of saints remain,
And call thy wrath to mind;
Give them like forests to the fire,
And make them seek thy Name
Or else their stubborn rage confound,
That they may die in shame.

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
